result.topic_en: A heavily corrected draft of a report to the Royal Finance Ministry on the Hannover/Göttingen widows' fund. It discusses how to estimate the ratio of widows to contributors once the fund reaches a steady state, and lists the data (registers of widows' ages, contributor and widow tables) needed for the calculation.

methods.what: Estimating the steady-state ratio of widows to contributors in a widows' pension fund, from mortality tables and the fund's own past experience

Es würde sich hiernach zunächst darum handeln, [-die Anzahl-] das Verhältniß {+Anzahl+} der Witwen zu der Anzahl

items.english: Accordingly, the first task would be to determine the ratio of widows to the number of all contributors that must be expected once the fund has reached its steady state.

items.english: The number of widows that would have to be expected, had the number of members remained constant, can be determined with an uncertainty of 1 to 2%.
